gbm_population_evidence.quote: New or recurrent glioblastoma diagnosed by neuroimaging techniques for which surgical resection is indicated

candidate_evidence.quote: Arm I (Defactinib): Patients receive 1 dose of defactinib PO while on study, prior to planned tumor resection.
Arm II (Avutometinib): Patients receive 1 dose of avutometinib PO while on study, prior to planned tumor resection.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: New or recurrent glioblastoma diagnosed by neuroimaging techniques for which surgical resection is indicated
